name: Daily digest
description: Summarizes cost or usage since yesterday and month to date from the sources you name, and flags anything over a budget or jumping. Sends the digest, keeps a JSON history, and files a task on a budget breach.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Files, folders or URLs that report cost or usage.

thresholds.title: Thresholds
thresholds.description: Budgets and jump size, such as: day=20 month=400 jump=50%.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.description: Agents to message; empty messages the owner.
